sources.title: Snapchat cuts 16% of global staff, around 1,000 jobs in latest round of mass layoffs
sources.description: The owner of social media platform Snapchat said Wednesday the company is eliminating about 16% of its global workforce, or about 1,000 jobs that will be culled in its latest round of layoffs.

sources.title: Snap is cutting 1,000 jobs, 16% of its workforce | TechCrunch
sources.description: The company cites advancements in AI for the cuts. CEO Evan Spiegel also wrote that the company is closing more than 300 open roles. Snap had about 5,261 full-time employees as of December 2025.

sources.title: Snap lays off 1,000 employees, shuts over 300 open roles - BusinessToday
sources.description: The visual messaging service app, Snap Inc has laid off 16% of its workforce amid investors pressure.

sources.title: Snap is cutting 20% of its staff as ad sales continue to dry up
sources.description: In a letter to staff members on Snap Inc.’s website, CEO Evan Spiegel said sales were not keeping up with projections.
